sigma_specification.notes: Official Sigma Rules Specification v2.1.0 verified from SigmaHQ/sigma-specification releases.

sigma_correlation_specification.notes: Lab correlation evaluator implements a documented subset only; full Sigma correlation semantics are out of scope for v1.0.

pysigma.security_notes: PyPI advisory list empty for 1.5.0 at verification date. Runtime network use by this lab is disabled; pySigma may declare transitive dependencies not invoked by lab offline paths.

sigma_cli.notes: Recorded for upstream awareness; the lab CLI uses the local package API, not sigma-cli.

mitre_attack.notes: Vendored subset only. Detection Strategies, Analytics, and Data Components validated against official ATT&CK objects referenced by this project. Legacy Data Sources are deprecated and not used as primary mappings.

update_process: Review official SigmaHQ specification releases and update sigma_specification fields.
Review PyPI and advisory databases for pysigma and backend packages; pin compatible ranges in pyproject.toml.
Review MITRE ATT&CK release notes; refresh the vendored subset and version.json without inventing IDs.
Resolve GitHub Action tags to full commit SHAs via the official repositories before updating CI.
Bump verification_date and document changes in CHANGELOG.md.
